gbm_population_evidence.quote: Clinical diagnosis of presumed high-grade glioma, based on image data.

candidate_evidence.quote: Investigators will use an imaging system during surgery to record the amount of ABY-029 in the participant's tumor and in the surrounding tissue.

role_evidence.quote: To measure of diagnostic performance of ABY-029, the false negative rate of ABY-029 fluorescence measured during surgery in tissue samples that are confirmed to be tumor through pathology.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-EGFR affibody fluorescent imaging agent for fluorescence-guided surgery

coder_notes: Fluorescence imaging agent for surgery, not therapeutic. Conditions list only 'Intracranial Tumor'; glioblastoma is never named. Tumour tissue ABY-029 signal is measured by imaging, but ABY-029 is a diagnostic agent, not a candidate, so tumour_pk_planned coded no. EGFR appears only as a keyword and in an exclusion criterion (anti-EGFR therapy), not as a biomarker.
